WITH cohort AS (
    SELECT id_bioguide, 
           MIN(term_start) as first_term_start,
           CAST(MIN(term_start) AS DATE) as first_term_date,
           EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(MIN(term_start) AS DATE)) as first_term_year
    FROM legislators_terms
    WHERE term_number = 0
      AND term_start >= '1917-01-01'
      AND term_start <= '1999-12-31'
    GROUP BY id_bioguide
),
years AS (
    SELECT 0 as y
    UNION ALL SELECT 1
    UNION ALL SELECT 2
    UNION ALL SELECT 3
    UNION ALL SELECT 4
    UNION ALL SELECT 5
    UNION ALL SELECT 6
    UNION ALL SELECT 7
    UNION ALL SELECT 8
    UNION ALL SELECT 9
    UNION ALL SELECT 10
),
check_dates AS (
    SELECT c.id_bioguide, 
           c.first_term_year,
           y as year_offset,
           c.first_term_year + y as check_year,
           DATE('1900-01-01') + INTERVAL (c.first_term_year + y - 1900) YEAR + INTERVAL 11 MONTH + INTERVAL 30 DAY as check_date
    FROM cohort c
    CROSS JOIN years y
    WHERE c.first_term_year + y <= 2025
)
SELECT cd.id_bioguide, cd.year_offset, cd.check_date,
       EXISTS (
           SELECT 1 FROM legislators_terms lt 
           WHERE lt.id_bioguide = 'C000174'
           AND CAST(lt.term_start AS DATE) <= cd.check_date 
             AND CAST(lt.term_end AS DATE) >= cd.check_date
       ) as has_term
FROM check_dates cd
WHERE cd.id_bioguide = 'C000174'
ORDER BY cd.year_offset

SELECT cd.id_bioguide, cd.year_offset, cd.check_date,
       EXISTS (
           SELECT 1 FROM legislators_terms lt 
           WHERE lt.id_bioguide = 'C000174'
           AND CAST(lt.term_start AS DATE) <= cd.check_date 
             AND CAST(lt.term_end AS DATE) >= cd.check_date
       ) as has_term
FROM check_dates cd
WHERE cd.id_bioguide = 'C000174'
